Project Description: Build a basic wallet application to generate public/private key pairs and store wallet addresses securely. Add functionality to send and receive test tokens on a testnet, and display transaction history fetched from the blockchain.

Deploy your own fungible token on Ethereum using the ERC-20 standard, defining properties like name, symbol, and total supply. Include functions for transferring tokens, approving allowances, and checking balances, then verify the contract on Etherscan.

Create a smart contract that allows users to mint unique NFTs with custom metadata such as name, image, and attributes. Store the actual media files on IPFS for decentralization, and build a simple frontend so users can connect their wallet and mint directly.

Build a tamper-proof voting application where each vote is recorded as an immutable transaction on the blockchain. Ensure only registered/whitelisted addresses can vote once, and display real-time results as votes are cast.

Store blog post content on IPFS while recording ownership, timestamps, and edit history on-chain for transparency. Allow authors to sign posts with their wallet to prove authenticity, and let readers verify a post hasn't been tampered with.

Lock funds sent by a buyer in a smart contract until predefined conditions, like delivery confirmation, are met. Include a dispute mechanism where a third-party arbiter can release or refund funds if buyer and seller disagree.

Allow campaign creators to set a funding goal and deadline, and let users contribute ETH toward that goal. If the goal is met by the deadline, funds are released to the creator; otherwise, contributors can claim automatic refunds.

Let participants deposit a fixed amount of tokens into a pool to enter a lottery round. Use a verifiable random function (like Chainlink VRF) to fairly select a winner, and automatically transfer the pooled funds to them.

Create a contract that locks a beneficiary's tokens and releases them gradually according to a predefined schedule, such as monthly cliffs. This is useful for simulating team/investor token allocations and preventing early sell-offs.

Build a wallet that requires approval from multiple designated owners (e.g., 2 of 3) before any transaction can be executed. Include functions to propose, approve, and execute transactions, along with owner management.

Implement a basic automated market maker (AMM) that lets users swap between two ERC-20 tokens using a liquidity pool. Calculate exchange rates using a constant product formula (x*y=k) and allow users to add/remove liquidity.

Enable users to list their NFTs for sale, browse listings, and purchase NFTs directly through the platform. Support royalty payments to original creators on every resale, and include filtering/search functionality for the frontend.

Store hashed identity credentials on-chain so users can prove their identity without revealing sensitive data directly. Allow third parties (like employers or services) to verify a credential's authenticity by checking the on-chain hash.

Track a product's journey from manufacturer to distributor to consumer by recording each checkpoint as an on-chain event. Generate a QR code for each product so consumers can scan and view its full history for authenticity verification.

Allow institutions to issue academic or professional certificates as NFTs tied to a recipient's wallet address. Employers or other verifiers can instantly confirm a certificate's authenticity by checking the blockchain record instead of contacting the issuer.

Let users lock (stake) their tokens in a smart contract for a chosen duration to earn rewards over time. Calculate rewards based on staking duration and amount, and allow users to withdraw both stake and rewards after the lock period.

Create a platform where users sign petitions using their wallet address, ensuring each signature is unique and verifiable. Display a live signature count and prevent duplicate signing through smart contract logic.

Upload files to IPFS and store their content hashes along with ownership metadata on the blockchain. Allow users to prove file ownership and integrity at any time by comparing the current file hash to the recorded one.

Build a wallet contract that restricts fund withdrawal until a specific date or block number is reached. Useful for simulating savings accounts, vesting, or inheritance scenarios where early access needs to be prevented.

Allow users to lend crypto assets to borrowers who provide collateral exceeding the loan value. Implement interest calculation and an automatic liquidation mechanism if the collateral value drops below a safety threshold.

Build a simple contract/dApp that distributes small, fixed amounts of test tokens to users for free, typically for testnet use. Add rate-limiting (e.g., one claim per address per day) to prevent abuse of the faucet.

Create a smart contract that automatically transfers a user's assets to designated beneficiaries if the owner's wallet remains inactive for a set period. Include a "check-in" mechanism so the owner can reset the inactivity timer periodically.

Let users bet tokens on the outcome of a real-world event (e.g., election results, sports scores). Once the event resolves, distribute the pooled funds proportionally to users who bet on the correct outcome.

Issue reward tokens to customers for purchases or engagement, redeemable later for discounts or perks. Build merchant-side functionality to mint points and customer-side functionality to view balances and redeem rewards.

Build a platform where employers post jobs and freelancers apply, with payment held in escrow until work is completed. Include a milestone-based release system so freelancers get paid incrementally as they complete project phases.

Build a messaging application where messages are encrypted client-side and recorded as blockchain transactions between two wallet addresses. Only the intended recipient's private key can decrypt and read the message content.

Represent fractional ownership of a real estate property as ERC-20 or ERC-1155 tokens that investors can buy and trade. Include a mechanism for distributing rental income proportionally to token holders.

Create a governance system where token holders can submit proposals and vote on how to spend a shared treasury. Automatically execute approved proposals (like releasing funds) once a voting threshold and deadline are met.
Issue event tickets as NFTs, embedding event details and a unique ID to prevent counterfeiting. Allow ticket resale through the platform while enforcing price caps or royalties to prevent scalping.

Automate simple insurance payouts using smart contracts that trigger when predefined, verifiable conditions are met (e.g., flight delay data from an oracle). Remove the need for manual claims processing for straightforward, parametric insurance cases.
Build a tool that checks exchange rates for a given token pair across multiple liquidity pools or DEXs. Route the user's swap through the pool offering the best price, minimizing slippage and fees.

Track a user's trustworthiness by analyzing their on-chain transaction history, such as completed trades or repaid loans. Generate a reputation score that other dApps (like lending platforms) can query to assess risk.

Reward users who provide liquidity to a pool with additional governance or reward tokens over time. Implement a reward-per-block calculation so users earn continuously based on their share of the pool.

Allow users to register human-readable names (like "alice.eth") that map to their wallet address, similar to ENS. Include functions for renewing, transferring, and resolving these names to their linked address.

Let donors send funds to specific causes and track exactly how those funds are spent by the receiving organization on-chain. Provide a public dashboard showing total donations, fund allocation, and spending transparency in real time.

Build a tool that lets project owners upload a list of wallet addresses and automatically distribute tokens to each one. Use a Merkle tree structure to make claims gas-efficient, letting users claim their allocation individually.

Build a simple gambling game where users bet tokens on a coin flip or dice roll outcome. Use a verifiable random function to ensure fairness, and automatically pay out winnings to the winning address.

Match freelancers and clients on a platform where project payments are held in escrow and released upon milestone completion. Include a rating system so both parties can review each other after the project concludes.

Restrict access to premium content (articles, videos, communities) based on whether a user holds a specific NFT or minimum token balance. Verify ownership by checking the connected wallet before granting access to the frontend.

Record attendance for events or classes as immutable, timestamped entries linked to a participant's wallet address. Generate verifiable attendance certificates or NFTs for participants who meet a minimum attendance threshold.

Simulate transferring tokens between two separate test blockchains by locking tokens on the source chain and minting equivalent tokens on the destination chain. Include a "burn and unlock" mechanism to reverse the process and return original funds.

Issue a governance token that grants holders voting power proportional to their holdings. Let holders create and vote on proposals for protocol changes, with votes weighted by token balance at the time of the snapshot.

Recreate a rotating savings and credit association where a group of members contributes a fixed amount each cycle. Automatically rotate the pooled payout to a different member each round based on a predetermined order.

Let users hash and timestamp important documents on the blockchain to prove they existed in a specific state at a specific time. Allow anyone to verify a document's integrity later by comparing its current hash to the recorded one.

Simulate a basic financial derivative where two parties agree on a future price for an asset, with settlement based on the price at expiry. Use a price oracle to fetch the real-world asset price for accurate, automated settlement.

Distribute streaming or sales royalties automatically to artists and collaborators based on predefined percentage splits. Record every payout transparently on-chain so all stakeholders can verify they're being paid fairly and on time.

Allow users to combine two NFTs they own to generate a new, unique NFT with traits inherited from both parents, similar to CryptoKitties. Implement randomized trait generation so each offspring NFT has a unique combination of attributes.

Build a tool that collects anonymous survey responses while using wallet signatures to prevent duplicate or fake submissions. Aggregate and display results in real time without ever linking responses back to identifiable personal data.

Implement deflationary tokenomics by automatically burning a small percentage of tokens on every transfer or transaction. Track and display the total supply reduction over time to show the token's shrinking circulating supply.

Automate a rental agreement where tenants pay rent through a smart contract on a recurring schedule. Automatically hold the security deposit in escrow and release it back to the tenant (minus any deductions) at the end of the lease.

Build a dashboard that connects to a user's wallet and displays their token holdings, current values, and historical performance. Pull live price data from an oracle or API to calculate the total portfolio value in real time.

Store product or service reviews immutably on-chain, tying each review to the reviewer's wallet address to prevent fake or duplicate reviews. Optionally require proof of purchase (like an NFT receipt) before allowing a review to be submitted.

Demonstrate how a user can borrow a large amount of funds without collateral, as long as the loan is borrowed and repaid within a single transaction. Build a simple use case, like arbitrage between two prices, to show the concept practically.

Grant exclusive perks, content, or community access to users who hold a specific membership token or NFT. Include tiered membership levels where holding more tokens or rarer NFTs unlocks additional benefits.

Issue tokenized carbon offset credits representing verified emission reductions, which companies or individuals can purchase and retire. Track the full lifecycle of each credit on-chain to prevent double-counting or fraudulent claims.

Build a contract that automatically divides any incoming payment among multiple recipients based on predefined percentages. Useful for splitting revenue among business partners, collaborators, or a team without manual calculations.

Verify event attendance by having attendees scan a QR code that triggers an on-chain check-in transaction linked to their wallet. Use the recorded check-in data to distribute POAP-style NFTs as proof of attendance.

Showcase digital artwork as NFTs in a virtual gallery, allowing collectors to browse pieces by artist, collection, or price. Implement an auction feature where users can place bids and the highest bidder wins the artwork after the auction closes.

Automate recurring crypto payments for services by allowing users to authorize a contract to pull a fixed amount at set intervals. Include functionality for users to cancel their subscription at any time, stopping future automated charges.

Track a product's warranty status and any ownership transfers on-chain, tied to a unique product ID or NFT. Allow the current owner to file a warranty claim directly through the platform, with the manufacturer verifying eligibility instantly.
